references.text: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise
See, I have taught you statutes and laws, just as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.
The Lord says: Because this people draw near to Me with their mouth and honor Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me, and their fear toward Me is a commandment taught by men
But He answered and said to them, Why do you also break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
Thus He declared the first covenant obsolete. And what is becoming obsolete and growing old is ready to vanish away.
